integrity: Mathematical steps are independently derivable from the definitions; same-model review only, with no independent validation or priority certification.
scientific_limitations: The rooted-tree recurrence assumes one pendant leaf at each core vertex; the general graph formula is not a polynomial-time recurrence for arbitrary core graphs.
Does not establish unimodality, log-concavity or real-rootedness of the corona polynomial in every tree.
Finite exhaustive checks are corroboration, not proof of the all-order claims.
Publication-priority comparisons are provisional because some relevant research may be unindexed.
title: Exact general-position polynomials of tree coronas via rooted-subtree recursions
